articulation.label: out
articulation.alt: out: /aʊ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue; round the lips.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: cow
articulation.alt: cow: /k/ → /aʊ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue; round the lips.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: town
articulation.alt: town: /t/ → /aʊ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue; round the lips.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: house
articulation.alt: house: /h/ → /aʊ/ → /s/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /h/: Gentle breath; mouth prepares for the vowel.
/a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue; round the lips.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
